fact: On 7 May 2025 UNDP sought a consultant to apply and improve the Own-Source Revenues System, developed under the Upper Egypt Local Development Program, in four pilot governorates (Fayoum, Beni-Suef, Luxor, Aswan) and the Ministry of Local Development, in an EU-funded project implemented by UNDP.
title: Consultant for Developing Own Source Revenues System at the Four Pilot Governorates and MoLD
